name: DoCoMo Saipan / MCV Saipan Data Center
notes: Saipan/Susupe colocation facility listed by Baxtel and Inflect; DOCOMO PACIFIC's official business site confirms it operates colocation data center facilities with power, cooling, security, connectivity, direct fiber links, and SLA-backed service, but does not publish a Saipan-specific MW figure.

name: IT&E Guam & CNMI Saipan Data Center
notes: Saipan/Susupe data center listed by Datacenters.com and Inflect as an operational colocation/data center facility; IT&E's business pages advertise Data Center Services and regional enterprise services in Guam and CNMI. Public MW capacity not found.

name: Tinian Pacific Connect Initiative Core Connectivity Hub / Cable Landing Station
developer: CNMI Broadband Policy & Development Office, Google, Citadel Pacific / IT&E
notes: Official CNMI BPD page says CNMI will develop a core connectivity hub on Tinian, landing up to four subsea fiber optic cables and constructing a cable landing station, conduits, and supporting infrastructure over three years. Google announced Proa/TPU extensions to CNMI and core ICT nodes in CNMI and Guam. Included as adjacent data infrastructure; not a conventional compute data center, and no MW capacity disclosed.
